search_window.basis: Since latest independently verified Food Line Source Watch heartbeat completed November 7, 2026 at 22:45:15.238 PST. Search recency of 3 days accommodates publication/indexing lag; only newly corroborated, nonduplicate reports in this hourly observation interval qualify.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary high-value recall only; primary nationwide Food Line production collection remains authoritative, not inspected or changed.

coverage_notes.assessment: Twelve targeted web searches plus seven successful direct-source checks identified no source-verified, newly reported, nonduplicate U.S. disruption in the four requested miss classes since 22:45:15.238 PST.
coverage_notes.limitations: Supplementary bounded indexed search, not comprehensive national collection; local provider posts and indexing may lag. Several search hits were temporally irrelevant despite date filters. Official pages without update timestamps cannot prove no interruption elsewhere. Production ingest and deduplication were not inspected.
coverage_notes.action_limits: One append-only JSON heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger only; no approval, publication, merge, schedule change, task disabling or production change.
